text.jp:
このままクラス制覇となるか！？
次の戦いにも注目です！
text.official_en: But will he beat the other trials that await him in this league!? Join us for his next fight to find out!
text.real_en: Will he go on to conquer the entire tier? Keep your eyes on his next battle!

text.jp: この功績は、我が国で永遠に語り継がれることでしょう！
text.official_en: This amazing achievement will no doubt be echoed in the annals of our nation, to be remembered forever!

text.jp:
これまでとは比べ物にならない試練が待ち受けるが
果たしてこの試練を突破することはできるのか！？
text.official_en: Trials that make what we have seen so far look like child’s play await in this unforgiving league. Does our stalwart commander have what it takes to come out on top!?

text.jp:
さぁ、やってきました「上級」のバトル！
その覇者が再び登場です！
text.official_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is one who has previously vanquished the Gladiator League!
text.real_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is one who has previously vanquished the Advanced tier!

text.jp:
さぁ、やってきました「中級」のバトル！
その王者が再び登場です！
text.official_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is one who already stands victorious over the Brawler League!
text.real_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is one who already stands victorious over the Intermediate tier!

text.jp:
さぁ、やってきました「初級」のバトル！
その勝者が再び登場です！
text.official_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is one who has already conquered the Fledgling League!
text.real_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is one who has already conquered the Beginner tier!

text.jp:
さぁ、やってきました「超上級」バトル！
その絶対王者が再び登場です！
text.official_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is none other than the unrivaled king of the Champion League!
text.real_en: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen! Returning today is none other than the unrivaled king of the Super Advanced tier!

text.jp:
さあ、いよいよ闘技場の難関「上級」の
バトルに挑戦する猛者の紹介をしましょう！
text.official_en: Next, permit me to introduce the puissant pugilist who is taking on the Gladiator League!
text.real_en: Now, allow me to introduce the formidable contender taking on the Advanced tier!

text.jp:
さあ、闘技場「中級」のバトルに挑戦する
手練れの紹介をしましょう！
text.official_en: Allow me to introduce our confident contestant who is taking on the Brawler League!
text.real_en: Allow me to introduce our confident contestant who is taking on the Intermediate tier!

text.jp:
さあ、闘技場「初級」のバトルに挑戦する
腕自慢の紹介をしましょう！
text.official_en: Allow me to introduce our confident contestant who is taking on the Fledgling League!
text.real_en: Allow me to introduce our confident contestant who is taking on the Beginner tier!

text.jp:
さすがはレイン隊長、再びの勝利！
次の戦いへの期待も高まります！
text.official_en: And yet another win for Commander Rain! What fearsome foe will he face next!?
text.real_en: Commander Rain has won again, just as we'd expect! Now we can't wait for his next battle!

text.jp:
しかし、戦いのステージはこれだけでは済まない！
ぜひ、全クラス制覇に向けて頑張っていただきたいですね！
text.official_en: But the battle is far from over for him in this Colosseum... Let us hope he continues to fight, rising through the ranks to conquer every league that stands in his way!

text.jp:
それでは、上級クラスバトル
はじめ！！！
text.official_en: Without further ado, let the Gladiator League battle begin!
text.real_en: Without further ado, let the Advanced tier battle begin!

text.jp:
それでは！
我らがレイン隊長に盛大な拍手をー！
text.official_en: Now, please give a loud, thunderous round of applause to...Commander Rain!

text.jp:
それでは！
我らがレイン隊長に盛大な拍手をー！
text.official_en: Now, please give a loud, thunderous round of applause to...Commander Rain!

text.jp:
それでは！
我らがレイン隊長の戦いっぷりに盛大な拍手をー！
text.official_en: Please give another round of applause to Commander Rain!

text.jp:
なんということでしょう！
これで闘技場のすべての戦いを制したことになります！
text.official_en: Holy smokes! Could it be!? Commander Rain crushed each and every battle this Colosseum can throw at him!

text.jp:
なんと！　上級クラスの戦いは
全て制覇されてしまったようです！
text.official_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Gladiator League battles!
text.real_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Advanced tier battles!

text.jp:
なんと！　中級クラスの戦いは
全て制覇されてしまったようです！
text.official_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Brawler League battles!
text.real_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Intermediate tier battles!

なんと！　初級クラスの戦いは

text.official_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Fledgling League battles!
text.real_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Beginner tier battles!

なんと！　超上級クラスの戦いも
全て制覇されてしまったようです！
text.official_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Champion League battles!
text.real_en: Ladies and gentlemen...it appears Commander Rain bested ALL the Super Advanced tier battles!

text.jp:
もちろんこの人！
我らがグランシェルト騎士団のエース！
レイン隊長だーーーッ！
text.official_en: Is there even any doubt about whom I speak!? The Grandshelt Order’s finest of the finest: Commander Rain!

text.jp:
もはや生ける伝説！
我らがグランシェルト騎士団のエース！
レイン隊長だーーーッ！
text.official_en: A living legend, and the Grandshelt Order’s finest of the finest: Commander Rain!

text.jp:
初級といえども油断は禁物！
果たしてこの試練を突破することはできるのか！？
text.official_en: Although it may be the lowest class in the Colosseum, it’s not to be taken lightly! Does the dauntless commander have what it takes? Let us find out!
text.real_en: Even at the Beginner tier, you mustn't let your guard down! Can he overcome this trial!?

text.jp:
初級を乗り越えた勢いで
中級も突破することはできるのか！？
text.official_en: Will he be able to maintain his momentum from the Fledgling League into the Brawler League? Hold on to your seats, ladies and gentlemen, for we are about to find out!
text.real_en: Will he be able to maintain his momentum from the Beginner tier into the Intermediate tier? Hold on to your seats, ladies and gentlemen, for we are about to find out!

text.jp:
我らがグランシェルト騎士団のエース！
レイン隊長だーーーッ！
text.official_en: The Grandshelt Order’s finest of the finest: Commander Rain!

text.official_en: The Grandshelt Order’s finest of the finest: Commander Rain!

レイン隊長だーーーッ！
text.official_en: The Grandshelt Order’s finest of the finest: Commander Rain!

text.jp:
既に制覇したとはいえ気は抜けない！
勝利の栄冠を再び手にすることはできるのか！？
text.official_en: He may have overcome this league before, but can he do it again!?
text.real_en: He's cleared this tier before, but he still can't let his guard down! Can he claim victory again!?

text.jp:
既に制覇したとはいえ油断は禁物！
再び勝利を手にすることはできるのか！？
text.official_en: He may have overcome this league before, but can he do it again!?
text.real_en: He's conquered this tier before, but he can't afford to let his guard down! Can he win again!?

text.jp:
既に制覇したとはいえ難関の試練！
勝利を再び見ることはできるのでしょうか！？
text.official_en: He may have bested this league before, but these remain some of the toughest battles the Colosseum has to offer! Will he stand triumphant once more!?

text.jp:
既に頂点を極めた存在ですが
いったいどこまで勝利を追い求めるのでしょうか！？
text.official_en: Can his insatiable thirst for victory ever be quenched!? Let’s find out!
text.real_en: He's already reached the very top, but how far will he keep pursuing victory!?

text.jp:
最後の難関「超上級」のバトルに挑戦する
強者の紹介をしましょう！
text.official_en: And finally, it gives me great pleasure to introduce the formidable fighter who is taking on the Champion League—the most testing tier of the Colosseum!
text.real_en: And finally, it gives me great pleasure to introduce the formidable fighter who is taking on the Super Advanced tier—the most testing tier of the Colosseum!

text.jp:
皆さん！　偉業を成し遂げたレイン隊長に
大きな拍手をーーー！！！
text.official_en: Ladies and gentlemen...please give the biggest applause to Commander Rain for making history today!!!

text.jp: 見事上級の戦いを制しました！
text.official_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Gladiator League round!
text.real_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Advanced tier round!

text.jp: 見事中級の戦いを制しました！
text.official_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Brawler League round!
text.real_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Intermediate tier round!

text.jp: 見事初級の戦いを制しました！
text.official_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Fledgling League round!
text.real_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Beginner tier round!

text.jp: 見事超上級の戦いを制しました！
text.official_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Champion League round!
text.real_en: And Commander Rain comes out victorious from this Super Advanced tier round!

text.jp:
限界を超えた先にそびえたつ壁を
さらに打ち砕いて突き進むことができるのか！？
text.official_en: Can the steadfast commander ascend to new heights and take us to a place of unimaginable excitement?
text.real_en: After surpassing his limits, can he break through yet another towering obstacle and press onward!?
